$comment: feat-018 BR-RT-9: the panel's lazy conversion of a stored plain description to html. Panel: convert(plain) = html. Server: reduce(html) is the identity (a fixed point), counts as `count` and fits the ceilings. A case with a `generator` has no inline text: both suites build it (repeat-amp-100000: 100 000 '&' in one paragraph, 500 007 markup code points; lf-100000: 100 000 line feeds, 100 001 empty paragraphs, 700 007 markup code points; both 100 000 visible at most, US-4 'Legacy worst cases fit the ceiling').

cases.note: Lines are paragraphs, an empty line an empty paragraph.
Leading spaces, a tab and a run of spaces stay as they were.
CR LF and lone CR become LF before the split.
Markup characters in plain text are text.
100 000 '&' in one paragraph: 500 007 markup code points, 100 000 visible.
100 000 line feeds: 100 001 empty paragraphs, 700 007 markup code points, 100 000 visible.
